dishes.n: Colony crumbed sardines with lemon mayo
dishes.make_ahead: Make the lemon mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and crumb the sardines up to 3 hours ahead on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the butterflied sardine fillets dry.
Toss in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the panko mixed with the zest of the lemon and salt.
Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill.
Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Colony crumbed eggplant fingers with lemon mayo
veg.make_ahead: Make the lemon mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and crumb the eggplant up to 3 hours ahead on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into finger-sized strips, salt them for 5 minutes and pat dry.
Toss in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the panko mixed with the crumbled nori, the zest of a lemon and salt.
Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill.
Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the dressing up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and fry the bacon up to 1 day ahead; cut the wedges and assemble on the night

steps.text: Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with lemon and pepper.
Fry the rashers bacon until crisp and crumble.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with bacon and the diced tomato.

veg.make_ahead: Make the dressing up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and toast the almonds up to 3 days ahead; cut the wedges and assemble on the night

steps.text: Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon and pepper.
Toast the smoked almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes, cool and chop.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with the almonds and the diced tomato.

dishes.make_ahead: Assemble the pie up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake on the night

steps.text: Poach the white fish in the milk for 5 minutes and flake.
Make a sauce with the butter, the flour and the poaching milk, add the peeled prawns and chopped parsley, and pour into a dish with the fish.
Top with the potatoes mashed with the butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

veg.n: Mumble's smoked tofu and egg pie
veg.make_ahead: Assemble the pie up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake on the night

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and quarter.
Soften the leeks in some of the butter.
Stir in the flour, then the milk, and simmer to a sauce. Add the smoked tofu, chopped parsley and eggs and pour into a dish.
Top with the potatoes boiled and mashed with the rest of the butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Mix the desiccated coconut, the condensed milk and the icing sugar into a stiff paste.
Press half into a lined 20cm tin, tint the rest pink with a drop of colouring and press on top.
Chill 2 hours until firm and cut into squares.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended to order; hull the strawberries and chill the glasses up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Hull the strawberries and blend with the vanilla ice cream and the cold milk until thick and pink.
Pour into tall chilled glasses.
Whip the cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and scatter with pink sprinkles and a halved strawberry.
Serve straight away with wide straws.
